notes: Unity 6 AudioSource keeps its clip in m_Resource; SoundManager fields (level0) point at AudioSources, so refs with via=AudioSource go through the source.
kind: music = long background loop clips (sonami music, sleep); loop = clip on a looping AudioSource; oneshot otherwise.
sources: AudioSource components (file = scene or asset file; prefab objects inside sharedassets*). refs: MonoBehaviour PPtr fields.
